scope: Iterative repository-wide local audit and fixes; Mobile remains isolated on its feature branch and legacy Agent is not extended.

changes.finding: 15 integration settings were absent from Turbo, including an additional withdrawal scale switch found during execution.
changes.fix: Pass/hash all 47 configured settings; discover integration switches from tracked test sources so omissions fail the contract check.

changes.finding: New database/storage suites and several separate verification commands were never enabled in CI.
changes.fix: Provision/migrate isolated platform and project-move databases; execute 18 platform suites serially with mandatory flags and reject skipped assertions. Reuse the existing local MinIO fixture. Add migration, workspace permission, project move, maintenance script, server-rendered player and health HTTP checks.

changes.finding: The old HTTP suite expected a removed Hello World endpoint; internal ESM package imports, two Crew component fixtures and three Agent OS discovery fixtures had stale test wiring.
changes.fix: Use real health/readiness HTTP routes with owned dependency fixtures, map internal Agent packages to their real TypeScript source in Jest, isolate new children in parent Crew tests, and include the current island-count contract in creator-discovery fixtures.

changes.finding: The supported 1000-beneficiary reversal exceeded the existing 15-second transaction timeout while issuing thousands of per-recipient queries.
changes.fix: Batch ordered member locks, earning/event writes and notification/outbox writes in the same transaction. Preserve existing receipt keys, payout reservations, immutable accounting events and atomic rollback. Posting and reversal each assert fewer than 50 database queries at 1000 beneficiaries.

RETURNING identifies only newly inserted notification rows for outbox enqueue. Sort unique keys consistently across overlapping batches; bounded 250-row chunks; late failures roll back earlier chunks. Existing single-send behavior remains unchanged.

Use Buffer.equals for exact multi-megabyte storage comparisons. Give the opt-in large retention fixture enough setup/scan time without weakening query-count assertions. Server mixed unit/integration tests use a 30-second default for tests/hooks; production transaction/request timeouts remain unchanged. Recycle default Jest workers above 512 MB between suites to bound retained module contexts; targeted serial suites remain available.
Correct AGENTS.md to COM Azure AKS/ArgoCD and CN Aliyun ACK with an ECS build host.

changes.finding: The broad PostgreSQL run exposed a host/VM clock dependency in an expiry-after-lock test.
changes.fix: Set the competing expiry using PostgreSQL clock_timestamp(), matching the service clock and preserving the lock-wait assertion.

changes.finding: The installed Google Interactions SDK throws a separate APIError hierarchy, so HTTP validation, permission and quota errors bypassed the ApiError mapping and became generic UNKNOWN failures. Long-running operation google.rpc.Code values also bypassed HTTP-only mapping. Terminal Omni responses discarded their message. Failed tiles truncated errors and provided no task identifier.
changes.fix: Map both SDK error families and canonical operation codes through existing categories/retry rules; preserve terminal provider messages. Add a localized, copyable failure-details dialog with the existing public message, task ID, model and error code. Historical jobs remain reportable by ID; no raw response or headers are added to the UI.

health_http.conditions: Real Nest routing with storage/database/Redis collaborators replaced by owned fixtures, not a full production boot.
